evidence.locator: The page lists the Chandra X-ray image alone (a1689_xray) and the Hubble image alone (a1689_opt) as JPEG and TIFF, each 3853 x 4000 px on one frame, and wide-field versions of both. Chandra ACIS, 53 hours in five pointings from 2004 to 2006 (Obs. ID 540, 1663, 5004, 6930, 7289); X-ray in purple. The TIFFs' embedded scale is half the true one. Measured on the Hubble layer against Gaia DR3: 67 of the 71 catalogued sources in the frame have a peak at their place, rms 0.18 arcsec, giving 0.0500 arcsec per pixel, north 115.22 deg right of vertical, centre 197.875322, -1.338501, a field of 3.21 x 3.33 arcmin.
